Topics: container identity; workplace labels; safety data sheets; hazard pictograms and statements; employer written program; PPE and control ownership; storage and incompatibility awareness; spill exposure and emergency handoff. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Hazard-communication literacy only. Actual chemical use, PPE, ventilation, storage, spill response, waste handling, and emergency procedures come from the employer program, product information, and applicable authority.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Battery & Charging Awareness. Topics: battery and device identity; approved charger ownership; designated charging area; visible damage and swelling; unexpected heat odor or leakage; impact and unknown history; hold and report state; repair shipping disposal boundary. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Awareness only. Exact charging, storage, isolation, emergency response, shipping, disposal, repair, and reuse decisions remain with the employer, manufacturer, carrier, fire/life-safety process, or other responsible authority.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Truck Staging, Dock Interface & Load-Lead Handoff. Topics: dock schedule and owner; case destination and priority; staging lanes; manifest and count interface; trailer and vehicle status; dock plate lift-gate ramp awareness; load-lead and driver authority; unresolved freight closeout. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Assigned staging and handoff only. Vehicle operation, powered loading equipment, load distribution, securement approval, weight compliance, dock equipment operation, and final truck-pack decisions remain external.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Return Reconciliation, Damage Quarantine & Closeout. Topics: return work order; count and identity reconciliation; accessory reconciliation; visible damage state; quarantine or repair lane; cleaning and maintenance ownership; inventory-state restoration; missing and unresolved closeout. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Bounded assigned-support education. The responsible employer, lead, department, venue, manufacturer, or current site plan controls actual work.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Employee vs Independent Contractor Literacy. Topics: label versus actual relationship; behavioral control; financial control; type of relationship; economic dependence concepts; multiple legal tests; state and local variation; official determination and advice routes. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Legal/tax awareness only. Worker status is determined by applicable law and actual facts; course completion cannot classify a person, waive employee rights, or replace agency/professional advice.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Freelance Crew Business Basics. Topics: client identity and contact; scope and work order; W-9 awareness; invoice identity and dates; expense and reimbursement record; payment terms and receivable state; business record organization; professional advice boundary. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Business literacy only. This course does not establish contractor status or provide individualized tax, accounting, insurance, contract, or legal advice.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Rates, Scope, Expenses & Payment Terms. Topics: hourly day and project rate concepts; included time and scope assumptions; travel lodging meals and mileage; reimbursable versus included expense; cancellation and changed scope; approval owner; payment terms; dispute and collection escalation. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: General business education only. Local wage law, overtime, reimbursement rules, contracts, taxes, union/CBA terms, and client agreements can control actual payment rights and obligations.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Work Records, Timekeeping & Payment Reconciliation. Topics: call sheet and schedule; actual in out and breaks; task or job reference; rate or pay basis record; invoice or payroll reference; payment and remittance match; difference and dispute state; record retention and privacy. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Recordkeeping literacy only. Personal records do not replace an employer’s legal recordkeeping duties and do not determine compensable-time, wage, tax, or contract disputes.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Worker Rights, Reporting & Retaliation Awareness. Topics: safety concern routing; pay and time concern routing; discrimination and harassment awareness; accommodation request awareness; retaliation awareness; union and CBA process awareness; fact and record preservation; agency and professional help boundary. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Rights-navigation awareness only. Exact coverage, deadlines, remedies, protected activity, union/CBA processes, and legal strategy depend on the actual jurisdiction, worker status, employer, agreement, and facts.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Production Advance Packet & Responsibility Matrix. Topics: show and version identity; contact and decision owners; venue and site constraints; department requirements; labor and schedule dependencies; transport dock access and credentials; open questions and due points; responsibility matrix and handoff. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Management-system education only. Completion does not create appointment, signing authority, engineering authority, legal authority, or specialist authorization.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Labor Calls, Schedule Dependencies & Change Communication. Topics: milestones and phases; predecessor dependency; department handoff; labor quantity and role assumption; call time versus task duration; contingency and recovery; schedule change log; communication and acknowledgement. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Management-system education only. Completion does not create appointment, signing authority, engineering authority, legal authority, or specialist authorization.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Budget Tracking, Quotes & Change Control. Topics: estimate versus approved budget; quote and scope basis; quantity rate and unit assumptions; commitment and purchase state; change request; approval owner; actual cost and variance; audit trail and unresolved financial item. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Management-system education only. Completion does not create appointment, signing authority, engineering authority, legal authority, or specialist authorization.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Show-Day Issue Log, Closeout & Postmortem. Topics: timestamped issue record; affected area and impact; decision owner; current status and next checkpoint; safety incident process boundary; equipment vendor labor open items; financial and document closeout; postmortem and corrective action. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Management-system education only. Completion does not create appointment, signing authority, engineering authority, legal authority, or specialist authorization.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Accessible Routes & Public-Interface Awareness. Topics: public versus work-only routes; accessible route awareness; doors aisles and egress interface; cable crossings and temporary surfaces; ramps platforms and level changes; cases barricades and queue changes; temporary closure and alternate route ownership; reporting and accessibility authority. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Accessibility awareness only. Actual ADA/code applicability, route dimensions, approvals, accommodations, and event/venue compliance decisions remain with the responsible covered entity, venue, designer, AHJ, accessibility professional, or other authority.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Captioning, Assistive Listening & Communication Access Awareness. Topics: effective communication concept; captioning display interface; assistive-listening interface; interpreter and sightline interface; program audio and feed ownership; content accuracy and timing; request and accommodation routing; failure reporting and backup ownership. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Interface awareness only. Accommodation decisions, legal sufficiency, content accuracy, interpreter/captioning qualifications, assistive-listening deployment, and venue/system configuration remain with the responsible organization and specialists.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Production Network Cyber Hygiene. Topics: account and credential ownership; MFA and password-manager awareness; phishing and suspicious messages; approved software and updates; removable media and downloaded assets; show-file backups and version integrity; unauthorized devices and network changes; incident reporting and recovery ownership. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Defensive awareness only. No penetration testing, credential bypass, exploit use, unauthorized discovery, covert access, or unapproved configuration is taught or authorized.

scope_note: Evidence basis for Heat & Changing-Conditions Awareness. Topics: heat and workload interaction; acclimatization awareness; water rest shade or cooling access; PPE and clothing interaction; indoor and outdoor heat sources; symptom and condition reporting; work modification or hold ownership; emergency and medical boundary. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Awareness only. Employer heat plans, work/rest controls, acclimatization programs, medical response, emergency procedures, and any applicable legal thresholds remain with the employer/site/qualified process.

scope_note: Evidence basis for First Five Calls: A Beginner Work Path. Topics: before call one; arrival and check-in; assignment confirmation; ordinary movement and work-area habits; department ownership; standby break reassignment and release; timekeeping and report-back; choose a department pathway. Course maturity: authored_frontier.
authority_note: Beginner orientation only. Every real call still follows the employer, venue, department lead, applicable training, equipment instructions, and site-specific authorization.
